integrity: The Hom-Lie identities, twist centralizer, Nijenhuis defects, deformation bracket, automorphism group, finite-field ranks, and orbit normal forms are reconstructed directly. The 2024 same-framework preprint was inspected in full for the defining identity and same-object overlap; finite enumeration is replay evidence rather than the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two is excluded because the plus-one and minus-one twist eigenspaces coincide.
The theorem treats one involutive Hom-Heisenberg algebra rather than all Heisenberg Hom-Lie twists.
The complete 2021 primary article was not available through the noninteractive lawful full-text routes used for literature comparison.
title: Nijenhuis geometry of an involutive Hom-Heisenberg algebra
